description: This file implements tensor copy and tensor creation functions specifically for Metal device tensors in PyTorch. It includes functions for copying data between CPU and Metal devices, creating uninitialized tensors with Metal backend, and registering Metal-specific functions with the PyTorch operator library. It also defines a Metal interface implementation to check availability and perform copy operations, integrating Metal support into PyTorch's tensor infrastructure.

classes.name: MetalImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the MetalInterface, providing methods to check Metal device availability and perform tensor copy operations specific to Metal.

methods.name: is_metal_available
methods.description: Checks if Metal is available on the current device (determined by compilation flag USE_PYTORCH_METAL and runtime MetalContext availability).

methods.name: metal_copy_
methods.description: Performs a tensor copy operation between input tensor and source tensor, handling CPU<->Metal device transfers.
